name: Crusher Row
design_intent:
CRUSHER ROW — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-3 TWIN-PRESS stage (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 17). The flagship three-island / one-void shape where the CENTRE island B is a stamping PRESS ROW: TWO VERTICAL crushers hammer straight DOWN on offset rhythms (phase 0.0 / 0.5, so they never slam together), with narrow heads and permanent clear lanes at B's edges and centre gap. The killer comes from ABOVE and the safe beat is a horizontal shuffle between the presses. Spawns are on islands A/C ONLY. Kill identity = time the presses, knock rivals under a descending head or off into the void. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

HAZARD DOCTRINE (crusher, vertical anvil x2): (1) LETHAL on contact via kill(&ring_out); no shove/hitstun, never sets last_attacker (untagged kill = uncredited self-fall; a knocker within 6.0s is credited). (2) TELEGRAPHY — a long ~1.76s OPEN DWELL with the top head parked HIGH (well above a standing player), then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH for telegraph_lead 0.6s BEFORE a fast ~0.34s slam (period 2.8s). (3) FAIRNESS — each press lane is NARROW (head_w 150): press1 covers x~1740..1890, press2 x~2170..2320, so B's LEFT edge (x1580..1740), CENTRE gap (x1890..2170) and RIGHT edge (x2320..2480) are ALWAYS clear standing refuges; the offset phase (0.0/0.5) means they never both slam at once; boosting UP above the parked head also clears a slam. Islands A/C are permanent refuges. NO spawns on B (a parked open head is lethal to brush contact).

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (the PRESS ROW, center 2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080, 680px void gaps. TWO vertical CRUSHERS, both head_len 160, head_w 150, open_gap 520, closed_gap 40, period_s 2.8, close_time 0.34, closed_time 0.2, retract_time 0.5, telegraph_lead 0.6: press1 center (1815,1080) phase 0.0 / press2 center (2245,1080) phase 0.5. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878. VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Overcast grey open_sky = a stamping mill.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CROSS the PRESS ROW on B: shuffle horizontally into a clear lane (left edge / centre gap / right edge always safe) on the 1.76s open beat, or boost up above the parked head; a mistimed stand under a descending press = instant off-screen kill. The presses never cover 100% of B's survivable space and never make a required gap uncrossable. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1192-1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = 670-686px of open sky (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back. Verb: FLY.
- Zero-boost from any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap (falls into the void): flight is REQUIRED; the presses time the fight on B but never create a bounce path across a gap. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the twin pile-drivers — dash the centre island between two offset stamps (distinct from press_gate's single horizontal gate and first_hammer's rotor).
